title: Investigate persistent blur after encoding improvements
goal: Identify resolution and optical causes using actual recordings and official camera documentation before further capture changes.
doneWhen: Separate verified pipeline limitations from optical/exposure hypotheses
Define a higher-resolution validation with camera negotiation and cadence checks
decisions: Preserve previous uncommitted changes and recordings
Do not start camera streams or restart production while operator hardware state is unknown

limitations: Actual negotiated camera modes were not measured; setter calls alone do not prove mode selection

Production services were not stopped or modified
